measurement.bounds: First decreased source read falls back to that variant item-replace request start. Target bounds include preceding zero/non-full reads, read order, polls and RCON uncertainty. measurement.assets: Independent variant/FE/mB ledgers, source counts, external outputs and zero local/SQL checks. SQL allocation/WAL/local mirrors never added as assets; different units never summed.
measurement.observer: No concurrent RCON clients. Shared Minecraft console reply buffer has no business nonce despite protocol IDs; every raw body retained, chest coordinates/strict components validated. RCON spans, guard SQL spans, polling lateness and actual phase duration recorded; driver-limited results are not capacity.
measurement.native_validation: Offline parser/math checks do not validate Minecraft/component command syntax or performance; --execute must produce real completed guarded windows.
measurement.revision: Inherited launch-selected class/resource/JAR manifests plus PID/world/session/epoch. Operator revision and checkout are labels, not loaded-code proof. Rehash at end.
measurement.config: Verified launch config path; start/end config-file hashes and only allowlisted observed transfer flags retained. Current file bytes/flags alone do not prove old runtime support or startup-loaded values.
measurement.barriers: One fixed ITEM pair per steady window drains and remains zero for2.2s before its confirmed external chest outputs are cleared. Warmup/final phases drain all three resources and all owned chests; timeout/failure keeps assets. Old324s scanner waiting stays visible, even when120s ITEM output is0.
measurement.metrics: Optional instrumented counter differences are actual counters; baseline WAL remains UNMEASURED. local_credit_publications includes cross delivery. Native local_input/output_units may mix resource units: not external business throughput/assets. Mod/MC end rings cannot establish phase-wide MSPT/TPS or p95.
measurement.full_window_probe: One continuous opt-in session from before steady counter_start through conservation/quiet and counter_after_drain; counter_end has an unsealed daemon prefix. Whole tickServer samples include Neo Pre/Post. Input and service loops are inherited unchanged; no rolling-percentile substitution.
measurement.pipeline_trace: Raw ITEM local input/capture/source-WAL/SQL deposit confirmation/reservation/destination-WAL/LOCAL/RX-apply events retain endpoint and operation IDs where the hook provides them. wal_return is a successful LocalJournal.write return, including identical-snapshot skips; it is not an independent fsync or power-loss measurement. local_input is the localChanged notification hook, not a replacement for physical source-chest observation. Missing hooks or stages are UNMEASURED. The current agent records resource kind, not a variant fingerprint: A/B external ledgers stay independent, but ambiguous internal operations must not be assigned a variant by order. Never subtract nanoTime across JVMs. Same-JVM deltas are valid; wall/nano anchors allow approximate alignment only, with 1ms wall quantization, non-atomic anchor reads, drift and scheduling uncertainty. This supplies no rigorous cross-JVM latency bound. External container request/reply intervals remain the E2E evidence; no WorldSave claim.
measurement.post_seal_resource_identity: Only after the complete measure returns and all JVM windows are sealed, read this fresh owned channel's traced business IDs joined to actual SQL resource payloads. Strict bounded AnyTag parsing and payload SHA256 validate the two fixed component identities. Unknown/missing IDs stay UNKNOWN; ordering is never identity proof. Queries add no timed-window cost. Hooks without a business ID remain unassigned even if their amounts match.
